Journal.Title: Journal of the American Chemical Society

Article.ArticleTitle: Cell-Selective Bioorthogonal Metabolic Labeling of RNA.

Abstract.AbstractText: Stringent chemical methods to profile RNA expression within discrete cellular populations remains a key challenge in biology. To address this issue, we developed a chemical-genetic strategy for metabolic labeling of RNA. Cell-specific labeling of RNA can be profiled and imaged using bioorthogonal chemistry. We anticipate that this platform will provide the community with a much-needed chemical toolset for cell-type specific profiling of cell-specific transcriptomes derived from complex biological systems.
